notes.title: Party Maker New Year's update
notes.content:
We have been reading and listening to your feedback and we hear you! More enjoyment - you say. Why is it ending already? With the next update, we're adding the ability to replay all completed levels after finishing the game. So, you can return to your favorite spot and have another go, this time with all the decorations unlocked.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36658449/bf31e876ba3ae5778ed9ebd231fae746318ae900.jpg

At the beginning of the new year, we will also provide a brand-new location!

We can't wait for your new compositions. Be sure to share them with us.

Let’s stay in touch!

Forestlight Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125890/Party_Maker/

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue - Language update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/71345e366000c8c6dae5a9c743ab4c431881f17e.jpg

Hello, Wedding Designer Prologue community!

For the last couple of weeks, a lot of you reported problems with translations to your languages. we took all the feedback to heart and had the whole game re-translated. 

We hope that for now, everything will be more clear, and your experience with the game will be a lot better.

Change Log:

Fixed translation issues for:

 Polish
 German
 Spanish
 Italian
 Russian
 Turkish
 Chinese
 English
 French
 Portuguese
 Korean

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue Update 2
notes.content:
Hello, Wedding Designer community!

We are happy to present you second big update to the Wedding Designer Prologue. 

We are still getting a lot of feedback, thanks to all of you for your help. Your ideas are always helpful when we work on new updates to the game.

Changes:
- Achievements on steam !!!
- Markings on the minimap.
- Corrected fonts.
- Minor changes to the quest with animals
- Optimization

Also, we are thankful for all Steam reviews. They are very important for us, so if you played Prologue, we will be honored if you leave your review on the Steam site.

If you have any issues with the game, join our Discord community. It's the fastest way to get your answers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/1828de088d8457f88d4fe698dfb4a19dea0e7c7b.png

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue Update v1.1b
notes.content:
Thank you very much for the kind reception of the Wedding Designer Prologue. It's crazy how much positive feedback we got.

Of course, we care about all ideas, and problems as much as we care about all positive feedback. 

That's why we recently released a big update that covers most of the problems you already reported.

- We have lowered the volume of the music in cutscenes.
- The time needed to beat Uncle Bob in the race is easier by 2 seconds.
- Animals in the headphone quest are now much easier to find.
- Hanging draperies shouldn't be a problem now.
- The tutorial on picking up garbage in the office has been changed. 
- We've added the ability to disable head bob in the options
- Quest with better results in the race is now hidden.
- There is now an option to skip the race quest.

Also, we are thankful for all Steam reviews. They are very important for us, so if you played Prologue, we will be honored if you leave your review on the Steam site. 

If you have any issues with the game, join our Discord community. It's the fastest way to get your answers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/1828de088d8457f88d4fe698dfb4a19dea0e7c7b.png

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue - Release day stream and Screenshot competition
notes.content:
Hello, Wedding Designer community!

Only one day left till the Wedding Designer Prologue release. To celebrate this wonderful occasion, we are announcing a big screenshot contest.

All you have to do is play Wedding Designer Prologue, and share with us some of the best screenshots you did while preparing for a party on the farm.

You can post your lovely shots to Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram with an obligatory tag #WeddingDesignerContest. Don't forget to tag us on your posts @forestlightgames on Facebook, @ForestlightG on Twitter, and @forestlight.games on Instagram

Best photos will be published on the game's Steam page, and their creators will also receive a Steam code for the Full Version of Wedding Designer! *

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/02f1340bc00bbdaf81a16229a9cba61de58f9123.jpg

But wait! There is more!

26th of May at 18:00 CEST we will host a special 1-hour developer stream, where you will be able to talk with us, see us playing the game, and ask questions that bother you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/0b73830fe449772cd3739476066cdd713fceea11.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/1828de088d8457f88d4fe698dfb4a19dea0e7c7b.png




*Keys will be distributed on Wedding Designer release day.

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue - release date announcement
notes.content:

Hello Wedding Designer Community!

We know you waited a little too long, but the time finally comes. 

We are happy to announce the 26th of May as a day of Wedding Designer Prologue release.

We did a great job and we are very pleased with the results. We are sure that you will love Wedding Designer as much as we did!

In the upcoming days, we will share more details about the content of Prologue. So stay tuned!
